profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Opsera
profile.summary: Software Engineer specializing in frontend development, UI engineering, and product-focused web experiences, based in San Francisco. Experienced in building scalable, responsive applications at venture-backed startups using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Led frontend development across multiple projects, contributed to production features and dashboard tools, and transformed Figma designs into polished, high-quality user experiences in fast-paced collaborative environments. Passionate about creating intuitive, visually engaging interfaces that balance strong technical execution with thoughtful design and usability. Looking to explore the cross-sections of technology and art/design in my career.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Founding Team
positions.description:
• Early-stage startup building a rental platform for indian event attire, centered on sustainable fashion, personalized fit, and seamless rental logistics through a Shopify-based storefront - worked directly with the founder/CEO across software engineering, internal operations systems, and day-to-day business workflows
• Designed and developed Marigold Helper, an internal rental operations dashboard for Marigold's Shopify storefront, centralizing order tracking, fulfillment status, and return shipment visibility in a single interface, deployed on Vercel
• Integrated the Shopify Admin GraphQL API and FedEx Track API using the client credentials flow to securely retrieve orders, rental dates, line items, and return-label events on the server
• Notable projects: Marigold Helper - decreased order and return shipment search time by over 50%
• Tech stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shopify Admin GraphQL API, FedEx Track API, HTML5, Vercel
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · React · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Shopify Admin GraphQL API · FedEx Track API · HTML5 · Vercel · Business Process Improvement · Business Operations · Cursor AI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Venture-backed startup (a16z, Basecase, AirAngels, Background VC) focused on improving on-call and incident management, and comprised of 10 people - worked primarily on the frontend side
• Developed pixel-perfect, responsive UI components by translating our designer’s Figma designs into fully functional web pages across various devices, including desktop and mobile
• Collaborated with team members to create stunning and functional UI components in a fast-paced start-up environment
• Utilized Slack Block Kit to enhance the beeps Slack assistant with visually appealing and interactive UI responses
• Leveraged various AI tools such as Copilot to optimize my work quality and efficiency
• Applied prompt engineering to optimize and customize responses from the beeps Slack assistant
• Integrated third-party components seamlessly into existing UI components
• Notable projects: Fully developed the frontend for arewedownyet.com, and built key pages for beeps.dev (home, team, schedule demo, status pages)
• Tech stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, Vercel
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · React · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · HTML5 · Vercel · Figma · Slack Block Kit · Prompt Engineering · Remote Work · HTML · CSS3 · User Experience (UX) · Framer Motion · Linear · REST APIs

projects.title: Marigold Helper
projects.description:
• Designed and developed Marigold Helper, an internal rental operations dashboard for Marigold's Shopify storefront, centralizing order tracking, fulfillment status, and return shipment visibility in a single interface
• Integrated the Shopify Admin GraphQL API using the client credentials flow to securely retrieve orders, rental dates, line items, and return-label events on the server
• Built core business logic to categorize orders by lifecycle stage (unfulfilled, shipped, recently fulfilled), calculate estimated ship-out dates based on rental windows and destination state, and return-tracking status through the FedEx Track API
• Implemented password-based authentication with Next.js middleware, and developed a dark-mode UI with collapsible, color-coded tables and direct links to Shopify Admin for operational efficiency
• Deployed the app on Vercel, enabling secure server-side API access and rapid iteration throughout development

Tech Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shopify Admin GraphQL API, FedEx Track API, HTML5

projects.title: AI Changelog Generator
projects.description:
• Designed and developed an AI-powered changelog generator using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to convert GitHub commit history into human-readable summaries
• Integrated the GitHub API to fetch commit data within a custom date range and processed it using OpenAI’s GPT-3.5-turbo model for clean, concise changelog generation
• Developed a dynamic typing animation header and a clean, responsive layout with styled calendar inputs and intuitive interactions
• Implemented hover-to-copy functionality for generated changelogs to streamline sharing and developer UX
• Deployed the app on Vercel for seamless performance and quick access during development iterations
• Tech stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, GitHub API, OpenAI API, Vercel

organizations.name: Alpha Kappa Psi (AKΨ) - Chi Gamma Chapter
organizations.position: VP of Membership • Jun 2019 - Feb 2020   |   Active Member · Dec 2018 - Jun 2022
organizations.description:
Alpha Kappa Psi (AKΨ) is the largest professional co-ed business fraternity in the nation and strives for its members to develop professionally and provides a large and accessible network of support. It was founded with the purpose of developing its members into principled business leaders.

Responsibilities and Accomplishments:
• Worked with other executive board members and met weekly to accomplish quarterly/yearly goals
• Organized several events for the active body
• Participated in and contributed to fundraising events, such as blood drives
• Hosted workshops, such as resume and networking improvement workshops
• Created mock business plans

organizations.name: Society of STEM Sisters
organizations.description: Society of STEM Sisters is an organization for women at UC Santa Cruz who are STEM majors. It supports women academically and socially while striving to help its members achieve a balance between both. I was a part of the PR & Marketing Committee.
